title: Aggregate by Region
prompt: Given table sales(region TEXT, amount INTEGER), implement totals_by_region(conn) returning a dict region → SUM(amount), sorted by region name (insertion order of the dict).

tests.name: sums per region
tests.code:
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
conn.execute('CREATE TABLE sales (region TEXT, amount INTEGER)')
conn.executemany('INSERT INTO sales VALUES (?, ?)', [('east', 5), ('west', 2), ('east', 3)])
conn.commit()
assert totals_by_region(conn) == {'east': 8, 'west': 2}
tests.hint: SELECT region, SUM(amount) ... GROUP BY region.

tests.name: empty table gives empty dict
tests.code:
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
conn.execute('CREATE TABLE sales (region TEXT, amount INTEGER)')
assert totals_by_region(conn) == {}
